name: MenuLoom – Restaurant Menu, Online Food Ordering & Table Reservations
author: Bokhtyer Abid

sections.description:
MenuLoom is a free restaurant reservation, menu and online food ordering plugin for WordPress. Publish your menu, let guests book a table, take pickup and delivery orders and run the whole day from one place in the WordPress admin. It does not need WooCommerce, has no paid tier and shows no upsell screens.

Use it for a restaurant, café, bar, bakery, pizzeria or takeaway. Guests book a table, browse the menu, order food and manage their booking or order from a secure link in their email, without an account.

Restaurant menu

  • Menus (breakfast, lunch, dinner) with serving days and hours, categories and dishes
  • Photos, sale prices, sizes (small, medium, large), add-on groups (toppings, sauces) and dietary tags
  • Per-dish availability: own days and hours, seasonal dates, a daily portion limit and a “sold out today” switch
  • A public menu with category tabs, search and dietary filters
  • A food grid of cards with search, category, dietary and price filters, sorting and “Load more”
  • Shortcodes and Gutenberg blocks for the menu, the booking form, the food grid and the customer account

Table reservations

  • Opening hours with split shifts, closed dates, blocked times, booking window and party-size limits
  • Tables and areas; the plugin assigns the best free table and joins tables for big groups
  • Two guests can never take the same last table: bookings are protected against race conditions
  • A booking form with a calendar that shows open, full and closed days; guests can choose how long they stay
  • Your own booking questions (short text, long text, choose one, tick box)
  • A waiting list: when a day is full, guests are emailed when a table frees up
  • Optional food pre-order with the booking, editable by the guest until a cut-off
  • Secure links in the emails to cancel, change the date or time, change the food and add the booking to a calendar
  • Reminder emails before the booking and a reminder to the owner about bookings that nobody has confirmed

Online food ordering

  • Add to cart on the menu and the food grid, a floating cart and checkout for pickup or delivery
  • Pickup and delivery times from the opening hours, preparation time and a limit per time
  • Delivery fee, free-delivery amount, minimum order and delivery areas with their own fees
  • Tips, tax and service charge, inclusive or added on top
  • Order tracking page and receipt by secure link; customers can cancel until the kitchen starts
  • Phone orders entered by staff
  • Payment is cash: at the restaurant, on pickup or on delivery

Customers

  • A customers list with booking and order history, notes, tags and merging of duplicates
  • Optional customer accounts with sign-in by email link or password, a page with their bookings and orders, and “order again”

Running the restaurant

  • A dashboard with today’s bookings, orders and sales
  • A kitchen screen with big buttons, sound for new orders and printable 80 mm tickets
  • Reports: busiest times, no-shows, revenue, top dishes, new and returning customers
  • Staff roles: Restaurant Manager, Host and Kitchen, without wp-admin rights
  • Email options: choose which emails the restaurant receives, set recipients for orders, write your own email subjects and texts, send a test email
  • An activity log that shows who changed a booking, an order or a customer
  • CSV export and a print list of bookings
  • A personal-data exporter and eraser for the WordPress privacy tools

Full feature list

Menu and dishes

  • Menus with serving days and hours, categories and dishes
  • Price and sale price, photo from the Media Library, featured dish, available or unavailable
  • Sizes (small, medium, large) with their own prices
  • Add-on groups (toppings, sauces) with a minimum and maximum number of choices, attached to dishes
  • Dietary tags (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, spicy) and allergen labels, with a public filter
  • Per-dish availability: own days and hours, seasonal dates, a daily portion limit and a “sold out today” switch
  • Lead time per dish, for example “order a cake 24 hours ahead”
  • Public menu with category tabs, search, dietary filters and your brand colour
  • Food grid with cards, a cart button and quantity stepper, search, category, dietary and price filters, sorting, “Load more” and shareable filter URLs
  • Cart suggestions (“Add a drink?”) before checkout
  • Shortcodes and Gutenberg blocks for the menu, booking form, food grid and customer account

Table booking

  • Opening hours with split shifts, closed dates, slot interval, dining duration, party-size limits and booking window
  • Blocked times for a private event or maintenance, for chosen tables or all tables
  • A limit on guests starting in the same time slot
  • Guests choose how long they stay, within your limit
  • Tables and areas; the smallest free table is assigned, or up to 3 free tables of one area are joined for big groups
  • Concurrency-safe booking with a database lock per date
  • Booking form with a custom calendar; it can open as a pop-up from the menu
  • Up to 6 of your own booking questions, shown in the booking details, emails, print list and CSV
  • Waiting list with a queue that moves one guest at a time
  • Food pre-order with the booking, optional or required, editable until a cut-off
  • Guest secure links: cancel, change date or time, change food, add to calendar (.ics)
  • Staff can create and edit bookings, choose the table and add food
  • List with filters, details, CSV export and a print list

Online ordering

  • Add to cart on the menu and the grid, options panel, floating cart and drawer
  • Checkout for pickup or delivery, as soon as possible or at a chosen time, with a note and delivery address
  • Times from the opening hours, preparation time, interval and a limit per time; menu days and hours are enforced
  • Delivery fee, free-delivery amount, minimum order and delivery areas with their own fee, free-over amount and minimum
  • Landmark field, a “rider will call you” line and days without delivery
  • Tips (suggested percentages and own amount), tax and service charge, inclusive or added on top, named by you
  • Prices are always calculated on the server, never taken from the browser
  • Order tracking page and receipt by secure link; cancel until the kitchen starts, with a cancel reason
  • “Order again” from the tracking page and the account page
  • Phone orders entered by staff

Kitchen

  • Kitchen screen with columns, one-tap steps, sound and a mark for new orders
  • Badges and tab title for new orders
  • 80 mm ticket printing
  • “Sold out today” from the kitchen

Customers and accounts

  • Customers table (guests included) with history, notes, tags, an account filter and merging of duplicates
  • Optional accounts with email-link and password sign-in, forgot and change password
  • Allow or block accounts per customer, an option to require an account to order, and a marketing checkbox
  • Account page with bookings, orders, details, a saved delivery address, order again and “delete my data”

Emails

  • Booking: received, confirmed, cancelled, reminder before the booking, changed by the guest, waiting-list notice and a digest of unconfirmed bookings for the owner
  • Orders: received, confirmed, ready or on its way, cancelled, and a new-order email to the restaurant
  • Choose which emails the restaurant receives and who gets order emails
  • Edit the subject and opening text of every email, and send a test email

Admin and owner

  • Dashboard with today’s bookings and guests, pending items, sales, orders, a trend chart and a getting-started checklist
  • Reports: busiest times, no-shows, revenue, top dishes, new and returning customers
  • Activity log: who did what and when, shown as History on a booking, an order and a customer (kept one year)
  • Mail and cron health: the dashboard warns when emails cannot be sent or the hourly job is stuck
  • Staff roles: Restaurant Manager, Host and Kitchen, without wp-admin rights
  • Settings for the restaurant, opening hours, booking rules, food ordering, notifications, appearance, shortcodes and advanced options
  • Brand colour for the public pages

Privacy and data

  • Personal-data exporter and eraser for the WordPress privacy tools, and suggested privacy policy text
  • No external services and no tracking cookies
  • Uninstall keeps your data unless you choose to delete it

Shortcodes

  • [menuloom_menu] – the public menu
  • [menuloom_booking] – the table booking form
  • [menuloom_food_grid] – dishes as cards
  • [menuloom_account] – customer sign-in and account page

Source code

The admin and public screens are built with React. The unminified source is included in the src/ folder of the plugin. To rebuild the files in build/, run npm install and then npm run build in the plugin folder.

Privacy

The plugin stores the name, email address, phone number, delivery address and notes that a guest enters when booking or ordering, together with the booking or order. It stores no card data and sets no tracking cookies. The cart is kept in the visitor’s own browser (local storage). Guests do not need an account. A customer who chooses to create one is given a WordPress user with a limited role and the standard WordPress sign-in cookie.

The plugin adds suggested text to the WordPress privacy policy page and registers a personal-data exporter and eraser (Tools → Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data). Erasing a person keeps the booking or order record, so sales and table history stay complete, but removes their name, email, phone, notes and address.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/menuloom-restaurant-menu-ordering or install it from the Plugins screen, then activate it.
  2. Open MenuLoom in the admin menu. Add your opening hours and restaurant details under Settings.
  3. Add your tables under Table & Seating and your dishes under Menu & Food Items.
  4. Put the shortcodes on your pages (or add the blocks): [menuloom_menu], [menuloom_booking] and, if you like cards, [menuloom_food_grid]. The Settings → Shortcodes tab has them ready to copy.
  5. To take online orders, switch on Settings → Food Ordering.
sections.faq:
Is this a free restaurant reservation plugin?

Yes. All features are free. There is no paid version and no upgrade screen.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. The plugin has its own cart and checkout. It does not depend on any other plugin.

Can customers order food online for pickup and delivery?

Yes. Switch on Settings → Food Ordering. Customers add dishes to a cart and check out for pickup or delivery. You can set delivery areas with their own fees, a minimum order, a free-delivery amount and a limit of orders per time slot.

Can customers pay online?

Not in this version. Payment is cash at the restaurant, on pickup or on delivery.

How do guests book a table?

Add the [menuloom_booking] shortcode (or the Restaurant Booking Form block) to a page. Guests pick a date, a time and the number of guests, and the plugin only offers times when a table is free.

Can two guests book the same table?

No. Bookings run inside a database lock, so two visitors cannot take the last table at the same time.

Do guests need an account?

No. Guests book and order without an account and manage their booking or order with the secure links in their emails. Customers who want an account can have one.

Is there a kitchen screen?

Yes. The Kitchen page shows orders in columns with big buttons, plays a sound for new orders and prints 80 mm tickets.

Does it work with my theme and page builder?

Yes. The menu, booking form and food grid are shortcodes and Gutenberg blocks, so they work in any theme and in page builders that accept shortcodes.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. All texts use the text domain menuloom-restaurant-menu-ordering, and you can write your own email subjects and texts in the settings.

Emails do not arrive. What should I do?

WordPress sends email through your host, and some hosts do not send mail at all. Use Settings → Notifications → Send test email. If it does not arrive, install an SMTP plugin.

Are reminder emails sent on time?

Reminders are sent by WordPress’s scheduler (WP-Cron), which runs when your site gets visits. On a very quiet site a reminder can arrive a little late.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Your bookings, orders and menu are kept unless you tick Delete all plugin data under Settings → Advanced. Deactivating never deletes data.

Does the plugin send data to other services?

No. It does not contact any external service. Emails go through your own site’s mail setup.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release: restaurant menu and food grid, table reservations with a booking form and waiting list, emails and reminders, guest self-service links, food pre-orders, online ordering for pickup and delivery, kitchen screen, customer accounts, reports, staff roles, dashboard, activity log, Gutenberg blocks and privacy tools.
